searchText: After a little more back and forth, I think we've settled on a pretty decent EIP! - No gas stipend - `authorized` is allowed to equal `tx.origin` - A handful of exceptional exits for bad behaviour. Nothing super major implementation-wise, just a couple tweaks. > authorized is allowed to equal tx.origin 🎉 Blame <@!543900561460822016> for that one. He went through a lot of contracts and contacted a few projects. We have three nodes on our EIP-3074 testnet! If you wanna play around with it: - Genesis and configuration: https://github.com/quilt/alpine-testnet - Geth: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/tree/eip-3074 (make sure you use the `eip-3074` branch) - Solidity: https://github.com/quilt/solidity/tree/eip-3074 (again, `eip-3074` branch) Ping me, <@!543900561460822016> or <@!415548822983278593> for some alpine ETH. It's still _super_ rough. Everything is pretty much untested at this point. YMMV https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-3074-auth-and-authcall-opcodes/4880/61?u=danfinlay dan's response

excerpts.author: samwilsn
excerpts.content:
After a little more back and forth, I think we've settled on a pretty decent EIP!

 - No gas stipend
 - `authorized` is allowed to equal `tx.origin`
 - A handful of exceptional exits for bad behaviour.

Nothing super major implementation-wise, just a couple tweaks.
